purpose: Request a narrowly bounded authorization to implement only the frozen deterministic CVGR contracts and turn the existing TDD red suite green while keeping optimizer execution and formal FFE prohibited.

bound_frozen_plan.amendment_rule: No frozen plan, test, fixture, endpoint, threshold, seed, budget or analysis rule may be changed under this authorization. Any necessary change stops implementation and returns to a separately versioned research-plan amendment.

I.meaning: Authorize creation of the allowlisted source files needed to satisfy the frozen graph, donor, fallback-RNG and FFE-accounting contracts.

T.meaning: Authorize execution of the four frozen pytest contract files and non-optimizer static checks only.

G.meaning: Authorize local Git initialization solely for code provenance; do not add a remote, push, publish or rewrite user files.

E.meaning: Keep optimizer loops, pilot/smoke benchmark runs, M/C1/F/C2, Stage B and full TCAC disabled.

F.meaning: No objective or constraint benchmark evaluation and no formal FFE may occur. Synthetic unit-test arithmetic and ledger mocks are not formal FFE and must not be reported as algorithm runs.

permitted_actions: Implement the minimum deterministic production code required by the frozen contract tests, without changing those tests or fixtures.
Populate local project metadata for the existing Python, NumPy and pytest environment; if a dependency is unavailable, stop rather than download or install it without a separate authorization.
Run only tests/test_graph_contract.py, tests/test_donor_contract.py, tests/test_fallback_rng_contract.py and tests/test_ffe_contract.py plus non-optimizer static/import checks.
Create a hash manifest, capture exact commands and exit codes, and preserve every failed test output before repair.
Initialize a local Git repository only if G is explicitly accepted; no remote, push, release or publication is permitted.
Prepare a new hash-bound execution-authorization candidate after the deterministic core passes; do not execute it.

required_contracts: known-block graph recovery and deterministic labels
empty, constant, unstable, low-constraint and nonfinite fail-closed behavior
domain-separated RNG streams and exact SHADE fallback
zero graph-pipeline FFE increment and cache-hit accounting
required_evidence: red-to-green command log with exit codes
confirmation that no optimizer run directory or benchmark result was created
confirmation that formal optimizer runs and formal FFE remain zero

hard_stop_conditions: Any frozen test, fixture, method specification, plan, preregistration or experiment-matrix byte changes.
Any need to call an objective or constraint evaluator, construct an optimizer loop, or run a benchmark problem.
Any fallback mismatch, FFE-accounting mismatch, silent NaN/Inf imputation or nondeterministic component labeling.
Any missing dependency that would require network access or environment reconfiguration not separately authorized.
Any attempt to infer performance, superiority, objective novelty, causal effect, physical validation or industrial validation from deterministic unit tests.
explicitly_not_authorized: parent SHADE optimization loop or complete experiment runner
optimizer pilot, smoke test or benchmark run
M, C1, F, C2, Stage B or full TCAC
any formal objective or constraint evaluation
result analysis, threshold tuning, parameter selection or post-result amendment
remote/HPC/cloud execution, paid services or network dependency installation
public release, repository push, preprint, submission or publication
performance, superiority, SOTA, objective-novelty, causal, physical-validation or industrial-validation claims

known_advisories.impact: Without local Git or an explicitly accepted alternative, final Stage 6 provenance cannot meet the preferred commit-plus-dirty-state contract.
The installed validator is missing _shared.decision_contract; this candidate therefore relies on its project-specific SHA-256 binding and must not be described as a passing Light decision checkpoint.
Successful implementation would establish code-contract compliance only, not novelty or publishable performance.
